title: Gemini in Chrome Is FREE in India? Here's the Paid Catch #shorts
description:
Gemini in Chrome is rolling out on Android in India. You can summarize pages and ask questions with the regular experience, but AUTO BROWSE for multi-step web tasks requires eligible Google AI Pro or Ultra access. English/device/age eligibility and rollout still apply.

Which would you use first? Comment 1 = Summaries or 2 = Auto Browse. Find our deeper explainer on FlowMinute Lab.

Official Google India announcement: https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/bringing-gemini-in-chrome-with-auto-browse-to-india/
Google Chrome requirements: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/17140089

Illustrative original video, not a product recording. #Gemini #Chrome #AI #India #shorts
